_comment: Lista blanca de argumentos de JVM que puede aplicar el asistente (set_jvm_args). Nunca se acepta texto libre. group 'gc' = recolector de basura: como maximo uno a la vez; se aplica con el preset de la instancia (java.preset) que ya entiende core/launch.js. 'args' se suman a los argumentos de la instancia. minJava = version minima de Java.

flags.description: G1 garbage collector with Mojang's tuning (short pauses). Safe default for most instances.

label.es: Flags de Aikar (G1 para modpacks grandes)

flags.description: Aikar's well-known G1 tuning set. Good for big modpacks with 6 GB or more of RAM.
Generational ZGC (Java 21+). Very low pauses; best with 8+ CPU threads and 6 GB or more of RAM. Worse than G1 on weak PCs.
Ignores explicit System.gc() calls that some mods make, avoiding stutters.

label.es: Reservar toda la RAM al iniciar

flags.description: Commits all the heap at startup: slower launch, fewer hiccups later. Only when the PC has plenty of free RAM.
Deduplicates identical strings to save memory in big modpacks.
Processes references with several threads during garbage collection.
Smaller object headers (Java 25+): less memory use and better cache usage.
